_comment: Default zone policy rules for Civillis.
Each entry uses: id + structures + rules.
allow_hostile_spawn: true means hostile spawns bypass civilization suppression in matched structures.
allow_mobs: optional mob whitelist when allow_hostile_spawn=false.
For this v1 default, we use one coarse rule that fully allows hostile spawn
inside large progression structures (plus desert/jungle temples and swamp huts),
and these VCs are also treated as 'non-civilized' by HUD / flee semantics.
Modpack authors can add/override files in data/<namespace>/civil_zone_policies/.
